title: 5 BIGGEST Religious Controversies of the Week | WTFaith News
description:
Welcome to WTFaith News – where facts meet faith and absurdities get debunked. In this episode we cover stories from Onam controversies in Kerala, the vandalism of the Ashoka emblem in Srinagar, and Ganesh Chaturthi processions abroad sparking noise complaints. We look at Taliban gender rules in Afghanistan blocking earthquake aid, and we expose the myths behind the lunar eclipse superstitions spread by astrologers.

At Pale Blue Thoughts, we stand for critical thinking, science over superstition, and the right to live free of dogma. From religion in public spaces to astrology vs science, this series brings a rationalist take on news at the crossroads of culture and belief.

This episode tackles Onam festival controversies, Islamist clerics in Kerala, and why Hinduism and astrology still fuel lunar eclipse myths. We break down how superstition and religion in India clash with science education and secular values. You’ll hear about Yuval Noah Harari-style insights on fictional realities like national symbols and culture wars, and how religious fundamentalism from Taliban Afghanistan to Kerala classrooms keeps colliding with reality. WTFaith News is Pale Blue Thoughts’ way of showing why science, reason, and critical thinking matter in today’s world.

#WTFaithNews #CriticalThinking #DebunkingSuperstition #ScienceOverFaith
